name: Question, testimony, observation, or hypothesis
description: Preserved with provenance; not treated as independent corroboration.

name: Physical or formal mechanism
description: A mechanism exists under defined physical, mathematical, or biological conditions.

name: Laboratory or controlled capability
description: A bounded implementation demonstrates a function under reported conditions.

name: Patent, named product, or commercial capability
description: A design or product is documented without automatically inheriting field-performance proof.

name: Institutional procurement, fielding, deployment, or adoption
description: A named institution documents operational adoption or normative recognition.

name: Cross-domain integration in one bounded system
description: Named stages operate together with synchronized records.

name: Scale, persistence, identity linkage, or retention
description: Records establish continuity, durable linkage, stored history, or system-wide reach.

name: Strategic intent, command, coordination, or mission
description: Direct operator, tasking, access, payment, mission, or command evidence.
